message.content: [{"citation_doc_id": "0", "citation_msg_index": null, "citation_begin": 0, "citation_end": 135, "citation_text": "The Plastic Ono Band is a band formed by John Lennon and Yoko Ono in 1969 as a vehicle for their collaborative and solo projects. "}, {"citation_doc_id": "0", "citation_msg_index": null, "citation_begin": 394, "citation_end": 820, "citation_text": "Following their marriage in 1969, they decided that all of their future endeavours would be credited to a conceptual and collaborative vehicle, Plastic Ono Band. "}]
